title: Weighted count of injective tuples
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $w$ assign a real weight to each subset of $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, with $w(S)\\ge 0$ for every subset $S$. The sum of the weights of the image sets of all injective maps from $\\{0,\\ldots,k-1\\}$ to $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$ is at most $k!$ times the sum of the weights of all $k$-element subsets of $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$.�
hypotheses_covered: $w$ assigns a real number to each subset of $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$
